document: R07 native macOS harness preparation evidence
status: source/package preparation only; Swift compilation and actual macOS/native acceptance blocked on Linux
base: Exact 0.11 experiment-02 contents; user application of 02 not independently verified. This delivery requires patch 02 first. No agent commit/push or production changes.

deliverable.host: Separate AppKit/WKWebView .app built locally with Swift via xcrun; own bundle identifier; repository-backed loopback asset host
deliverable.case_targets: 7 common candidate cases; save-failure case step-only; raw/adapted controls expose only the table/input case
deliverable.reporting: Manual attempts and fixture checks separate; local JSON checkpoints with bounded traces/snapshots; an observed failure stays failing in the same session
deliverable.privacy_scope: No automatic upload, clipboard read or production vault access; reports contain synthetic fixture snapshots and tester notes

node_core_adapter_checks.note: Includes one unchanged raw-history failure diagnostic, not 38 acceptance cases

native_support_tests.note: Tool gating, resources/paths and checklist tests; mocked Apple discovery is not actual Mac execution

capture_helper.scope: Capture/fixture helper, bounded export and key-character filtering only

verification.info_plist: Parsed with Python plistlib; distinct identifier and narrow local-network keys checked

limits: Candidate windows are independent, not one shared document across OS windows
WKWebsiteDataStore is nonpersistent; no native on-disk durability/crash proof
Native menus deliberately use responder-chain selectors; disabled/wrong routing must be recorded, not bypassed with JS
Origin candidate still lacks persistence/CLI/MCP parity
No architecture acceptance, native support claim, provider enablement or final desktop framework choice
next: User applies patch 03 after 02, runs native:mac on Mac, follows built-in checklist and shares the automatically saved JSON report. If setup fails, share native-setup-result.json plus compiler error. Continue independent R07 semantic/API work without selecting a stack.
